newsitem.title: USA: Dean Witter, Morgan studying merging futures units.
newsitem.headline: Dean Witter, Morgan studying merging futures units.

text.p: Dean Witter, Discover & Co is studying how to integrate its futures group with Morgan Stanley Group Inc after the firms in February announced the biggest merger ever in the securities industry, Dean Witter futures employees said Tuesday.
On Monday, futures executives at Dean Witter Reynolds Inc told a roomful of employees in Chicago that the two firms were now concentrating on merging their futures operations.
"They are definitely looking at this (futures) as a different stage of the merger," one Dean Witter futures employee said on condition of anonymity.

A Dean Witter futures trader said the firms were now "intensely" focusing on the futures side after Dean Witter said three weeks ago it planned to cut about 200 investment banking and research jobs following completion of the merger.
More meetings are scheduled for next week, the trader said.

Laurence Mollner, executive vice president at Dean Witter's futures division, could not be reached for comment. A spokeswoman for Dean Witter, Discover & Co would not comment on merging the futures businesses.
Dean Witter Reynolds Inc is the full-service securities business unit of Dean Witter and has been registered with the National Futures Association as a futures commission merchant since 1982.
The $10.3 billion merger is expected to be completed in mid-1997.
Both Dean Witter and Morgan Stanley's futures groups are headquartered in New York. ((Derivatives desk 312-408-8750)) E-mail derivatives@reuters.com
